Here is the final recap for the **Couch Captain Pet Photo Contest** campaign (`z513f`), which ran across the full five-day flight from **Thursday, February 11, 2027 through Monday, February 15, 2027** (Arizona time, `America/Phoenix`).

### Overall Campaign Totals
* **Total Spend:** **$647.47 USD** (`647,465,518` micros out of the $650.00 USD budget — 99.6% utilization)
* **Impressions:** **430,375** (reaching **387,969** unique users at an average frequency of **1.11**)
* **Link Clicks:** **262** (with **3,069** total engagements)
* **Completed Contest Entries ("Photo entered" conversions):** **44** (31 post-engagement, 13 post-view; **$14.72** average cost per completed entry)

---

### Performance by Ad Group (Line Item)

All ad groups were configured for website conversions (`WEBSITE_CLICKS` objective with `WEBSITE_CONVERSIONS` goal tied to the verified `"Photo entered"` web event tag `x8fqz`) and strictly targeted **United States** users aged **21+** (`AGE_OVER_21`) on X placements (`ALL_ON_TWITTER`):

| Line Item ID | Ad Group Name | Status | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Completed Entries ("Photo entered") | Cost / Entry |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `zh15y` | **US 21+ \| Pet Interests \| Best Converting Posts (3 & 4)** | Completed / Paused | $225.19 | 159,800 | 81 | **16** | $14.07 |
| `kuvzb` | **US 21+ \| Followers & Pet Keywords \| Top Posts (2 & 3)** | Completed / Paused | $208.86 | 132,760 | 96 | **13** | $16.07 |
| `jat6e` | **US 21+ \| Pet Interests (Dogs, Cats, Pets)** *(All 4 Posts)* | Paused Day 2 | $70.00 | 47,112 | 38 | **7** | $10.00 |
| `pkcsm` | **US 21+ \| Pet Interests \| Top Posts (2 & 3)** | Paused Day 3 | $70.00 | 41,177 | 22 | **5** | $14.00 |
| `mx1l2` | **US 21+ \| Followers, Lookalikes & Pet Keywords** *(All 4 Posts)* | Paused Day 2 | $60.16 | 39,480 | 25 | **3** | $20.05 |
| `z2p8x` | **US 21+ \| NFL & Photography Interests** *(All 4 Posts)* | Paused Day 1 | $13.26 | 10,046 | 0 | **0** | — |

---

### Key Optimization Decisions During the Flight
1. **Pruning Non-Converting Audience Segments (Day 1):** We initially tested three audience segments: Pet Interests (`Pets`, `Pets / Cats`, `Pets / Dogs`), Brand Followers/Lookalikes + Pet Keywords (`"my dog"`, `"my cat"`, `"pet photo"`, `"dog on couch"`, `"cat on couch"`), and broader Super Bowl NFL / Photography / Home interests (`z2p8x`). Mid-way through Day 1, `z2p8x` had delivered over 7,300 impressions with 0 link clicks and 0 entries, so we paused it and reallocated budget to the two pet-owner segments.
2. **Isolating Top-Converting Posts by Audience (Days 2–5):**
   * **Post `2152663719739489920`** generated 0 entries on ~$26 in initial testing, so we rotated away from it after Day 1.
   * **Post `2153026107602269511`** (*"Super Bowl sofa stars: your photo deadline is February 15, 2027!..."*) was the top overall performer across both audiences, driving **20 completed entries**.
   * **Post `2153207301534733117`** (*"United States pet owners aged 21+: enter Couch Captain free..."*) paired best with the **Pet Interests** audience (`zh15y`), contributing **8 completed entries** inside `zh15y` alone.
   * **Post `2152844913669137757`** (*"You bought the couch. Your pet inherited the entire estate..."*) drove strong click-through and conversion rates with **Brand Followers/Lookalikes & Pet Keywords** (`kuvzb`), delivering **8 completed entries** in `kuvzb`.
